    def __init__(self):

            self.mt[i] &= self.mask

    def _twist(self):

    def inv_right_shift_xor(value, shift):
        i = 0

        while i * shift < 32:
            part = (value >> (i * shift)) & ((1 << shift) - 1)
            value ^= part << ((i + 1) * shift)
            res |= part << (i * shift)
            i += 1

    def inv_left_shift_xor_and(value, shift, mask):
